name: Stellar Cyber Cases (Scoped API Key)
description: Read-only Case polling with scoped API key to short-lived JWT exchange. Limited by the service user's RBAC and tenancy.
setup_instructions: Use a dedicated local Stellar Cyber service user with the least RBAC and tenant scope required; SSO user credentials are not used for the API.
Provide the DP HTTPS origin as Host and paste the User Profile > API Keys scoped key into Refresh token. A username is not required for scoped key authentication.
The connector obtains a short-lived access_token with POST /connect/api/v1/access_token (Bearer scoped key), then uses Bearer access_token for GET /connect/api/v1/cases.
Confirm SSL trust, authenticate against a real read-only API path and inspect a sample response before starting the Stream or Route.

The default Case endpoint retrieves a bounded, score-sorted page. It is NOT exhaustive historical synchronization: configure and verify incremental pagination, deduplication and checkpoint behavior for your DP version before enabling continuous delivery.
The endpoint must be permitted by the scoped user's RBAC and tenancy; some administrative and data APIs require an all-access token and are not supported by this template.

preview.checkpoint_strategy: No automatic historical page/cursor is implied by this starter preset; validate an incremental strategy before activation.
preview.route_recommendations: Routes are created disabled; review tenant scope, mapping and delivery target first.
